page_title: ACM 0-0 GEN | AC Milan v Genoa 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but Nicola Leali comes off his line to gather the ball.

90+2' Aaron Martin (Genoa) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball goes high over the top of the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
90+1' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) replaces Alessandro Zanoli.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan). A free kick is awarded to Genoa.
89' Aaron Martin (Genoa) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

89' Good clearance! Vitinha (Genoa) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. The linesman makes the right call and Genoa will have a corner.
87' AC Milan work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

87' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
86' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
85' Aaron Martin (Genoa) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Mike Maignan.
84' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
83' Aaron Martin (Genoa) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
81' It looks like Vitinha (Genoa) saw red with that tackle. Marco Guida won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
80' Here is a change. Fabio Miretti is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Vitinha (Genoa).
79' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
78' Aaron Martin (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Samuel Chukwueze.
76' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
74' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Francesco Camarda, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
73' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

71' What a great effort! Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
70' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) commits a rough foul. Marco Guida stops the game and makes a call.
70' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

67' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marco Guida with no other option than to blow for a foul.
67' The resulting corner, taken by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan), comes to nothing.

67' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AC Milan.
66' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Now Genoa have a corner.
62' Substitution. Francesco Camarda (AC Milan) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Mattia Liberali walks off.
61' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Mattia Liberali (AC Milan) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
59' Mattia Bani (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
58' Mattia Liberali (AC Milan) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
57' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
56' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
54' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
53' Genoa are ruled offside.
51' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
51' Mattia Liberali (AC Milan) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul.
50' The ball is cleared after Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

46' What a save from Nicola Leali! Emerson Royal (AC Milan) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) comes off for Stefano Sabelli.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) is replaced by Alvaro Morata.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' A first-time shot by Emerson Royal (AC Milan) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.

44' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Nicola Leali!
42' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
42' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
40' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
36' Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
34' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
34' AC Milan take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
32' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Guida no option but to blow his whistle.
31' Genoa enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike. 57:43 – the ratio of ball possession.
28' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
27' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
27' The game is interrupted now, Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by AC Milan, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
26' A player from Genoa commits a rough challenge. Marco Guida blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. That's a free kick to AC Milan.

24' A big opportunity missed by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan). He got on the ball inside the box and thumped a splendid first-time shot on goal, but it went narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.
23' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) on the edge of the box. AC Milan get a corner.
22' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
21' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
20' Mattia Liberali (AC Milan) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
19' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
17' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
16' The Genoa players are exchanging some short passes.
14' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) jumps into a tackle and Marco Guida signals a foul.
13' Close! Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
11' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) works the corner short.
10' Mattia Liberali (AC Milan) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
9' The corner is swung in but AC Milan can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

8' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Nicola Leali easily deals with the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AC Milan.
8' A cross into the box from Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa) is cleared.
5' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' AC Milan are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The first half has just begun.
Genoa will kick-off.
Marco Guida will officiate today.
